Monster Files

Case Library

Each volume is a complete working week. Your personnel file carries class, Experience and inconvenient history into the next one.

How the Case Library works
  1. Start with Volume I. Its closing personnel number is captured by the Case Library.
  2. Open Volume II. The number is entered into its import field automatically.
  3. You may also paste or replace a personnel number above. It remains on this device.
  4. Every episode is a self-contained module. The Case Library can accept further volumes without changing the earlier games.
